corrections.corrected_text: ልኝ ፡ ይህን ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ይዤ ፡ ከተማ ፡ ገብ
corrections.reason: The 5th-order (ኃምስ) loop on 'ዤ' (ይዤ,gerundive 1st person singular) is clearly visible and required by grammar alongside 'ገብቼ' and 'አድርጌ'.
The 5th-order (ኃምስ) loop on 'ዤ' in 'ይዤ' is printed and required by the 1st-person gerundive sequence ('ጠጥቼ ፡ ሽሬ ፡ ወርቄን ፡ ይዤ ፡ ከተማ ፡ ገብቼ').
In Classical Ge'ez laryngeal verbs (ኀለፈ), the imperfect prefix vowel assimilates to 'የኀልፍ' (just as in L06 'ዓለሙኒ ፡ የኀልፍ'), which matches the printed glyph 'የ'.
